references.text: Previous verse describing which water-dwelling animals are permitted to eat - those with fins and scales
Repeats the prohibition against eating water-dwelling creatures without fins and scales, calling them an abomination
Parallel law in Deuteronomy that repeats the rules about clean and unclean water-dwelling animals with fins and scales
Further prohibition against eating creeping things, expanding the concept of unclean creatures
Concluding summary of the law concerning clean and unclean animals, including water-dwelling creatures
Isaiah condemns those who eat unclean things, including forbidden animals
Peter's vision about clean and unclean animals, showing the new covenant's understanding of food laws
